full_prompt_en: A square, richly rendered caricature illustration places two oversized male faces opposite one another above a town filled with orange fire. The left figure wears a dark rounded bowler hat and heavy coat; the right figure wears a close dark cap with round goggles and a blue gray jacket. Their upper bodies crop off the side edges, making the faces dominate the foreground. Both men have exaggerated long noses, wide pale eyes and tense open mouths. The man on the left turns toward the right, his large ear and sharply lined cheek lit by the fire below. The man on the right turns back toward him; a dense gray beard and moustache form a broad textured mass beneath his nose. Their expressions hold surprise or alarm without needing a caption. Between and behind them, dark smoke rises into the cool blue sky. Across the lower strip, pointed rooftops and thin chimneys form a compressed town silhouette in front of bright yellow and orange flames. Several propeller aircraft cross the sky at different scales. One larger plane near the upper center shows its warm underside and dark blue gray body, while smaller silhouettes recede toward the right and between the faces. The fire throws warm rim light onto hats, noses, cheeks and aircraft wings. Cooler blue daylight remains in the upper right, and heavy charcoal smoke darkens the area behind the left figure. The illustration gives skin smooth rounded shading, cloth a matte worn surface, beard hair fine directional texture, and metal aircraft firmer reflective edges. The foreground faces remain unusually sharp against softer smoke and the small detailed town. The overall composition creates a comic confrontation framed by destruction and movement, with orange light cutting through blue and charcoal shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节丰富的夸张漫画插画把两张放大的男子面孔相对放在橙色火焰充满的城镇上方。左边的人戴深色圆顶礼帽、穿厚外套；右边的人戴有圆形护目镜的贴头深帽，穿蓝灰夹克。两人的上身被画面侧边裁掉，使面孔主导前景。他们都有夸张的长鼻子、睁大的浅色眼睛和紧张张开的嘴。左边男子转向右侧，大耳朵和线条分明的面颊被下方火光照亮。右边男子回望他；浓密灰胡子和上唇须在鼻下形成宽大带肌理的团块。他们的神情显得惊讶或警觉，无需文字说明。两人之间及后方，深烟升入冷蓝天空。下方窄带里，尖屋顶和细烟囱在明黄橙火焰前形成压缩的城镇剪影。几架螺旋桨飞机以不同尺度穿过天空。上方中央附近较大的飞机露出暖色机腹和深蓝灰机身，更小的剪影退向右侧及两张脸之间。火光给帽子、鼻子、面颊和机翼镶上暖边光。较冷蓝色日光仍留在右上方，厚重炭黑烟雾使左侧人物身后的区域变暗。插画让皮肤具有平滑圆润的明暗，布料呈哑光磨旧表面，胡须有细密方向肌理，金属飞机的反光边缘则更硬。前景面孔在较柔的烟雾与细小城镇前保持异常锐利。整体构图以破坏和运动为背景构成漫画式对峙，橙光切穿蓝色与炭黑阴影。
style_prompt_en: The image has a polished caricature illustration finish with boldly inflated forms and finely differentiated surfaces. Smooth rounded modeling and sharp expression lines occupy the focal area, while smaller background marks and smoke soften into depth. Fiery orange and yellow light concentrates in one broad zone, pushing warm rim highlights against blue gray and charcoal surroundings. Cool space remains visible beyond the warm glow, keeping the contrast vivid rather than uniformly orange. Edges alternate between crisp silhouettes, fine hairlike texture and diffuse vapor. Foreground volumes are deliberately enlarged against much smaller receding forms, creating comic scale without flattening the scene. Matte and reflective details respond differently to the same light, making the exaggerated composition feel materially coherent. The overall effect is dramatic and playful, with hard focal precision and deep atmospheric color working together.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有精整的夸张漫画插画完成面，大胆膨胀的形体与区别细密的表面并置。平滑圆润的塑形和锐利表情线占据焦点，较小背景笔痕和烟状区域则向纵深柔化。炽橙与黄色光集中为一大块区域，把暖色轮廓亮边推向蓝灰与炭黑的周围空间。暖光之外仍看得到冷色空间，使对比鲜明而非全图同为橙色。边缘在清晰剪影、细毛状肌理和散开的雾气之间交替。前景体积有意放大，远处形体显著缩小，产生漫画尺度但不压平场景。哑光与反射性细节对同一束光反应不同，让夸张构图在材质上仍自洽。整体效果富戏剧性又俏皮，坚实的焦点精度与深远的空气色彩一起发挥作用。
theme_en: Two caricatured men facing each other above a burning town as aircraft cross the sky
theme_zh: 两个夸张造型的男子在燃烧城镇上方相对而立，飞机穿过天空
name: Tiago Hoisel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
